q10_q90: signed log1p of standardized quantiles, saturate at abs 1e6, divide by 5
roughness: log1p(mean(abs(delta value)/delta seconds)/scale)/5; pairs with 0<dt<=5 only
lag1: Pearson correlation of valid adjacent observations, constant=0
missing: None if baseline <2, observations <6, <3 adjacent pairs or missing either 0:30 or 30:60 coverage
